Alberta's rate in recent years:

| Year | Alberta, persons under 18 |
|---|---|
| 2022 | 12.0% |
| 2023 | 11.9% |
| 2024 | 12.8% |

- **Measure:** The MBM is Canada's official poverty line. Other measures, such as the after-tax Low Income Measure, give different rates. I didn't pull those.

The average is pulled up by high earners, so the median is the better guide to a typical Alberta income.

Source: Statistics Canada, Table 11-10-0239-01, "Income of individuals by age group, gender and income source, Canada, provinces and selected census metropolitan areas".

Source: Statistics Canada, Table 11-10-0135-01, "Low income statistics by age, sex and economic family type". Both figures are the percentage of persons under 18 in low income, for the 2024 reference year, and both carry a data quality rating of "good".
